title: 雨停之后
creation: Original native image generation followed by local GIF assembly
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production sprite sheet for a quiet hypnotic art GIF, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of nine equal square keyframes, edge-to-edge with no gutters, borders, labels or text. Each cell is a neighboring moment of ONE new original artwork titled conceptually 'After the Rain' (do not render the title). Prefer 1536x1536 or larger square for the complete sheet.
SUBJECT AND ORIGINAL COMPOSITION: turn the everyday materials of a rain-speckled vintage window into an abstract yet recognizable luminous woven image. Intact ribbed glass, a thin clear water film, a few irregularly spaced individual round droplets, and broad soft refractions of an amber light. Two or three OPEN, sinuous diagonal ribbons of fluted glass and reflected light travel across the scene, separated by generous smoky-green shadow. Their mirrored echoes gently answer one another at offset positions, like a relaxed woven textile, not a rectangular tile grid. Keep identifiable fine vertical glass ribs, a faint aged window edge, and the occasional natural water bead as tactile anchors. Use open branching caustic lines and soft transparent overlaps; the main shapes remain airy and unclosed. The design is asymmetric overall with subtle local mirrored rhythm. No flowers or plants, no wreaths, no medallions, no kaleidoscope eye shapes, no concentric rings, no tunnel, no broken or sharp glass, no dense clusters of round holes or bubbles.
COLOUR AND MATERIAL: smoky jade, muted petroleum green, pale champagne, a small amount of honey-amber light, hints of dusty copper. This is an intimate warm/cool balance, not cobalt blue and white. Fine real photographic glass detail blended with delicately painted light, faint film grain, tiny prismatic colour residues and soft pointillist shimmer. Rich and tactile, softly magical, restrained elegant highlights, gentle darks with visible detail. Calm and beautiful, a slightly nostalgic sense of looking closely at an ordinary evening after rain. Avoid glossy sci-fi CGI, neon, harsh high contrast, glitter showers and candy colours.
NINE KEYFRAMES: keep the same recognizable glass ribs, broad ribbon positions, framing, scale and average brightness in every cell. Across ALL areas at once, create small nearby changes in the refracted light contours, fine prismatic textures and glints on the existing droplets. The light seems continually re-imagined inside the same material, delicately re-resolving, without camera movement or spatial folding. Each neighboring moment differs by only a few percent, yet the fine details visibly vary. Changes are distributed, never an ordered spotlight traveling from object to object. The ninth cell should also be a near neighbor of the first, creating a comfortable seamless short cycle. Keep physical glass and droplets intact; no melting, stretching, swelling, vortex, broad fade, or scene transition. Output ONLY the exact 3x3 sprite sheet of this original glass-and-light artwork.
stylePrinciples: Familiar tactile materials transformed into a quietly magical visual field
Rhythmic visual echoes with distributed fine variations
Subtle prismatic detail and soft-glitch re-resolution
